reasoning: Round 4. Two fixes asked: (1) every site in the checked inventory accounted for exactly once, (2) split-rate discounting. I rebuilt the DCF from scratch as a quarterly site-by-site model valued at the 2027-10-01 horizon, which also clears the round-3 supervisor's points (unreconciled base, no roll-forward, pipeline bundled in, 85% margin). With round-3 inputs the rebuild gives contracted-only $5.04 vs the published $6.7. Walk to round 4, contracted-only, single rate: +$0.70 Fluidstack July-2026 amendments; -$0.24 $150M tenant fit-out; -$0.81 margin 85% to 82%; -$1.11 cash SG&A $90M to $140M (10-Q: H1 SG&A $254.7M less ~$185M SBC, which round 3 understated); -$1.77 ongoing SBC $80M/yr (judgment); -$0.21 Justified 6.8% NCI; -$0.48 Muskie cash collateral out of free cash => $1.12. Split-rate discounting (7.75% Google-backstopped, 9.0% unrated Fluidstack/Core42, 9.25% Justified, anchored on the 7.75% WULF Compute secured notes) adds $1.39 => $2.51. Pipeline, now site by site net of capex and obligations, adds $3.03 => DCF $5.54 (single $4.15). Cap-rate SOTP $8.68 (was $11.7) after the same site and cost fixes. Blend $6.8 (was $10.3). Mining is in, wound down by end-2027 with its power going to HPC (no MW counted twice); Abernathy is out except its $280M receivables; the FS option and Phase IV pursuits get zero. Ladder: as in rounds 2-3, at 91% vol a 12-month price does not converge to fair value, and the market prices pipeline and street targets ($34) far above my numbers. Most of the cut comes from cost and commitment corrections the market can see in filings, so I move the distribution down ~7% (median ~$12.5 to ~$11.6, P(>= spot) 0.405 to 0.367) and fatten the bottom strike slightly (contracted equity is thin). 1-month ladder unchanged. Thesis break $6.5 to $5.0. Scenario mean ~$13.4.

discounting.basis: 7.75% for in-term NOI backed by Google (Aa2/AA+), 44% of Fluidstack rent: equal to the coupon on the $3.2B WULF Compute secured notes against these leases (8.7% effective, BB, Oct 2025), between Hut 8's IG secured project notes (6.13%) and that effective cost, with the higher 10y since issuance offsetting the completion risk retired. Unrated: 9.0% for the unbacked 56% of Fluidstack rent and for Core42 (no backstop, $90M prepay). Justified: 9.25% (Anthropic unrated, IG support only expected, nothing built, $3.5B leveraged financing unpriced); 8.0% if IG support is finalized (+$1.02/share). Committed build capex at its project's rate. 10.5% WACC for post-term, mining, corporate, taxes, pipeline and terminal. Values per share at the 2027-10-01 horizon including the pipeline; contracted-only $1.12 single vs $2.51 split.
